summary: debt classifies mortgage/debt instruments from a curated static doc-type map (mortgageClassCodes / originatingMortgageCodes), not a live Document-Control-Codes lookup.
reason: The Document Control Codes dataset (7isb-wh4c) serves its doc__type column entirely null, so a live mortgage-code lookup builds an empty set and debt would report zero mortgages for every BBL. These ACRIS class codes are a stable published reference; only re-discover them live if that upstream column starts returning values.
validated_outcome: debt on a known-mortgaged Manhattan BBL returns the mortgage recordings with a summed recorded principal; live-verified against NYC Open Data.
